g.text: GOUGRA / NAVIZENCE WATER SYSTEM · ANNUAL WATER BALANCE, hm³/yr
State c. 1950: run-of-river use at Chippis, no storage in Anniviers; Turtmänna used in its own valley
Hatched: estimate, ceiling or not documented (small ones drawn at 4 hm³)

path.title: Gougra (Moiry) → AIAG intake at Vissoie: 36.8 hm³/yr
Lona → AIAG intake at Vissoie: 8.1 hm³/yr
Navisence at Mottec → AIAG intake at Vissoie: 126.7 hm³/yr
Moulins, Nava & laterals → AIAG intake at Vissoie: 37.5 hm³/yr
AIAG intake at Vissoie → Chippis–Navisence plant: 125.5 hm³/yr
AIAG intake at Vissoie → Bisse de Briey: 0.95 hm³/yr (estimate / ceiling)
AIAG intake at Vissoie → Navisence below Vissoie: 82.7 hm³/yr
Laterals below Vissoie → Navisence below Vissoie: 41.6 hm³/yr
Navisence below Vissoie → Bisse de Ricard: 3.5 hm³/yr (estimate / ceiling)
Navisence below Vissoie → Rhône at Chippis: 120.7 hm³/yr
Chippis–Navisence plant → Rhône at Chippis: 125.5 hm³/yr
Turtmänna → ITAG plants & river: 81.5 hm³/yr (estimate / ceiling)
ITAG plants & river → Rhône at Turtmann: 81.5 hm³/yr (estimate / ceiling)

g.text: • Natural runoff from BAFU MQN (modelled mean flows, recent reference period); glaciers were larger c. 1950, so absolute volumes are indicative.
• Gallery intake: monthly mean flow at Vissoie capped at 7 m³/s gives ≈ 126 hm³/yr; daily peaks would add spill. Gallery enlarged to 12 m³/s in 1954/55 (R01 p3).
• No residual-flow rules before 1958: water not taken by the gallery stays in the river. The Turtmänna split between ITAG plants and river is not documented.
• Concessions: Navisence Vissoie–Chippis to AIAG for 99 years (1905); upper Navisence to SIS (1908); Gougra waters granted 1943 (R04 p77).
Reference IDs [R##] are listed with page locators in EVIDENCE.md. Band widths are annual volumes; stage volumes are reused water and cannot be summed.
